items.title: Gemini 4 Neon
items.title_zh: 谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Neon，扩充以化学元素命名的前沿模型阵容
items.title_en: Google Releases Gemini 4 Neon, Extending Element-Themed Frontier Model Lineup
items.summary: Google announces Gemini 4 Neon, a new frontier AI model, sparking debate about confusing model naming schemes, relative performance versus competitors, and the increasingly jagged capability landscape.

items.title: Unauthenticated remote code execution in Nginx
items.title_zh: Wiz 披露 NGINX HTTP/2 未授权远程代码执行漏洞
items.title_en: Wiz discloses unauthenticated RCE flaws in NGINX HTTP/2
items.summary: Wiz discloses unauthenticated RCE vulnerabilities in Nginx's HTTP/2 implementation (CVE-2026-123633 and CVE-2026-123007), prompting debate over silent patching, real-world exploitability, and mitigation by disabling HTTP/2.

items.title: Xint 披露 5 个 nginx 漏洞，可打到主机 root
items.title_zh: NGINX2Root：五个 nginx 漏洞串联可拿到主机 root
items.title_en: NGINX2Root: Five nginx Flaws Chained to Host Root RCE
items.summary: Xint disclosed NGINX2Root, a chain of five nginx vulnerabilities plus a Linux kernel flaw that lets an unauthenticated nginx visitor escalate to host root, with fixes in nginx 1.30.7/1.31.9 and PoC exploit code released.

items.title: Seven new models at scalable price-performance
items.title_zh: 微软 Ignite 2026 发布七款 AI 模型，主打可扩展性价比
items.title_en: Microsoft unveils seven AI models at Ignite 2026, targeting price-performance
items.summary: Microsoft announced seven new AI models at Ignite 2026 focused on scalable price-performance, prompting community debate about model commoditization, competitiveness with Anthropic/OpenAI, and calls for open-weight releases.

items.title: Inside Deutsche Bank
items.title_zh: 德意志银行泄密文件分析依托 OpenAleph 与 FollowTheMoney 技术栈
items.title_en: Deutsche Bank Leak Analysis Built on OpenAleph and FollowTheMoney
items.summary: A consortium's investigation into Deutsche Bank publishes analysis of ~15 million leaked documents, with HN discussion covering the OpenAleph/ElasticSearch/FollowTheMoney data stack and debates over transparency and journalistic presentation.

items.title: Genie 4 is now available
items.title_zh: Google DeepMind 发布 Genie 4：可实时交互的世界模型
items.title_en: Google DeepMind ships Genie 4, a real-time interactive world model
items.summary: Google DeepMind has made Genie 4 available, prompting Hacker News discussion about access, pricing, capabilities, and the broader implications of generative world models.

items.title: 美国发布新规，堵住远程调用先进 AI 芯片的漏洞  美国商务部 11 月 16 日发布临时最终规则，把先进 AI 芯片与服务器的出口管制延伸到远程访问，防止绕道
items.title_zh: 美国将AI芯片出口管制延伸至远程云端访问
items.title_en: U.S. Extends AI Chip Export Controls to Remote Cloud Access
items.summary: The U.S. Commerce Department issued an interim final rule extending advanced AI chip and server export controls to remote access, aiming to prevent circumvention via third-country data centers.

items.title: 🤖 谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 模型  谷歌推出 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，主打日常编程与智能体工作流的快速执行，已向开发者、企业和
items.title_zh: 谷歌据报发布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，主打编程与智能体
items.title_en: Google Reportedly Releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen for Coding and Agents
items.summary: Google reportedly released Gemini 4 Hydrogen for everyday coding and agent workflows, claiming 2.5x faster speed, improved Terminal-Bench scores, and pricing at $1.5/$7.5 per million input/output tokens.
